A simple "back up when safe" would have resolved it without drama. **Would I have done the same?** - **No.** I’d have backed up after she left, since no one was behind me and she was clearly in the wrong. Escalating wasn’t worth it. Would you say the ATM setup was **clearly one-way** (making her wrong) or **ambiguous** (making it a gray area)? That could shift the perspective slightly.
